description: How to Start: Complete [The Beast in Me: City Center](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=930690) and receive a text from Claire some time later. _So, you're waiting for a date with Claire and her turbo-charged pet, Beast, away from all the city's hustle and bustle. I wonder how many bodies have been left to the bake in the Badlands sun after these races? Just do a me a favor and don't become one. Watch out for tumbleweeds, bumpy patches... armored Wraith trucks... Y'know, the usual._ Tips: - Save before the race, just in case of shenanigans. - You can only use Claire's car. Reward: - XP - Street Cred - Eurodollars

title: Riders on the Storm
description: How to Start: Receive a text from Panam some time after [Life During Wartime](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931596), and agree to help. _OK, this must actually be pretty serious. Tough chick like Panam wouldn't call you up for some chump chore. Must be something important. Wouldn't waste any time on this one if I were you. To the Aldecaldos' camp we go._ Tips: - Leaving the area after starting the job will cause it to fail - Be sure to grab [Problem Solver](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931609) Reward: - XP - Street Cred - Eurodollars

title: I'll Fly Away
description: How to Start: As part of [Life During Wartime](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931596), help Panam rescue Mitch. The job will appear here some time later, or be activated when Mitch gets in contact. _Something about corpses draws you to their unfinished biz, V. First, it was me... now Scorpion. Mitch wants you to fulfill his final request. Gotta admit it's got my curiosity piqued, but hey, as a dead guy, I'm biased._ Reward: - XP - Street Cred - [Action Figure](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931623) - [Stinger](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931624)

title: Gun Music
description: How to Start: Approach the area after completing [Riders on the Storm](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931608) _The Aldecaldos must really be desperate. To come this close to the city, and deal with scavs no less... Risky move. Sounds like they could use a hand._ Tips: - Invest in Body for a peaceful resolution. Reward: - XP - Street Cred

title: The Beast in Me: Santo Domingo
description: How to Start: Receive a text from Claire some time after [The Beast in Me: Badlands](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931604) _Ah, Santo Domingo! The eternal fountain of shit where the only sure thing was you'd eventually step on the toes of some hot-blooded jarhead with "6th Street" tatooed on his ass. You win this race, V, you show them who's in charge around here. You got a good shot too – I don't see this Claire slowing down until she reaches the finals._ Tips: - Save before the race in case of shenanigans - Buy a weaponised vehicle from AUTOFIXER and use it for an easier time - For the best outcome to the questline, use these dialogue options after the race: - Your driver, yeah. - Why tell me about him? - What's the connection to our race? - What happened to your husband exactly? - Tell me about this corpo Sampson? - You sure it was murder? - Want my help to kill Sampson? - My priority's winning. - When she texts you afterwards, choose 'Don't worry about it. Just remember what you promised me.' Reward: - XP - Street Cred - Eurodollars

title: Both Sides, Now
description: How to Start: Receive a call from Judy some time after calling Mr Hands as part of [M'ap Tann Pèlen](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=928222) _You ever hear the saying "No good deed goes unpunished"? You hold your hand out to someone, you get bitten. You help a poor soul in need, you get fleeced for all you're worth. Save someone's life? Fill in the blank._ Reward: - XP - Street Cred

title: With a Little Help from My Friends
description: How to Start: Receive a call from Panam some time after [Riders on the Storm](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931608) _The great nomad saga continues: Panam's up to something. That girl just doesn't know when to quit - and my God, I love her for it. You don't seem to know either, considering you wanna go back out there. Maybe you could save us all some time, pitch a tent out in the desert? Think we both know this isn't just about the job anymore._ Tips: - You can speak to Saul - sitting near the mission's starting point - and rat out Panam to receive [Mizutani Shion "Bonewrecker"](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931636) - This locks you out of one of the game's endings, and any further romance / jobs with Panam. - During the tower conversation, avoid saying that you're 'not doing this for free', or you'll be locked out of romance. Reward: - XP - Street Cred - Eurodollars

title: Queen of the Highway
description: How to Start: Complete [With a Little Help from My Friends](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931629) _Once you finally hit it big, always turns out you fucked something else up - Night City's golden rule. Panam got her Basilisk all right, but Saul's sure to toss her out before she even gets a chance to enjoy it. If you really like this girl, now's a good time to have her back._ Tips: - [Widow Maker](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=930415) is up for grabs if Nash wasn't killed during [Ghost Town](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=917787) Reward: - XP - Street Cred

title: The Beast in Me: The Big Race
description: How to Start: Complete [The Beast in Me: Santo Domingo](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931626) and receive a text from Claire some time later. _What now, V? Gonna help Claire stick it to the corpos who offed her husband? Or are you just hunting for that top spot on the podium? You know what I'd do if it were my call, but it's your hands on the wheel, not mine. You know... Claire's not so bad, after all. Kinda feel sorry for her actually. But like I said - your call. Good luck out there, turbo._ Tips: - Save before the race in case of shenanigans - Buy a weaponised vehicle from AUTOFIXER and use it for an easier time - Follow Sampson out of the race, then see [The Beast in Me](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=928227) for tips on getting the best outcome. Reward: - XP - Street Cred - Eurodollars

title: Coin Operated Boy
description: How to Start: Complete [Spray Paint](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931602) and return some time later. _All right, so I'm feeling like a sucker for this story. Do you really think Brendan is just spitting out the sentences it was programmed for? The stuff some marketing guru thinks customers want to hear? That'd be pretty fucked even by Night City standards. In any case, we won't know until you find him._ Reward: - None

title: I Fought The Law
description: How to Start: Take a call from Eliabeth Peralez, triggered some time after [Life During Wartime](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931596), and agree to meet her. _Look, if a job starts like a classic whodunit - some femme fatale calls you up, refuses to give deets and just calls a meet - one of three things is going down: you're dreaming, you're scrollin' a shit BD or someone's hazing you good. Think you can scratch the first two._ Reward: - XP - Street Cred - Eurodollars - [Peralez Campaign Poster](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931646)

title: I Really Want to Stay at Your House
description: How to Start: Begin a romantic relationship. _Gonna have a little date, huh? Knock yourself out. And don't worry – I'll close my eyes and plug my ears._ Reward: - None

title: Ex-Factor
description: How to Start: Receive a call from Judy some time after [Both Sides, Now](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931627) and agree to help her. _Someone once said, "No man ever steps in the same river twice." No clue who said it, but he was a smart dude. Now, there are lots of rivers in this world (most of them toxic, but whatever) – places you could explore instead of stomping over the same ol' grounds. And lots and lots of joyhouses. What's this one got that the others don't?_ Tips: - Be sure to grab [Death and Taxes](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931801) from Maiko's office. Reward: - XP - Street Cred

title: Fortunate Son
description: How to Start: Speak to Bob in the newly relocated camp some time after [Queen of the Highway](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931639) _Kidney failure. In the city, nothing that a stack of eddies and a few minutes won't solve. But in the Badlands... a death sentence. That is, unless a gentle soul somewhere feels like playin' guardian angel. Someone that'll get him the implant he needs before it's too late. Well, V? Think there 's anyone out there like that?_ Tips: - This job is time sensitive, so act fast! - For the best outcome, invest in Intelligence or spare the hospital employee. - As you go to leave, he'll tell you about the malware in the kidney, and provide a shard to neutralize it. Reward: - None

title: Sinnerman
description: How to Start: Receive a call from Wakako some time after [Life During Wartime](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931596) _You're right about one thing – this job from Wakako stinks to high heaven. Besides, you're above doing plain ol' hit jobs. Probably no harm in talking to Bill Jablonsky and seeing what his deal is. But if I were you? I'd take a hard pass._ Tips: - Play along, and get in the SUV to [continue the questline](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931807) Reward: - Eurodollars (if Joshua is killed)

title: There Is A Light That Never Goes Out
description: How to Start: Complete [Sinnerman](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931806) by entering the SUV. _I love these WTF situations. A guy hires you to off some other guy, and then that first guy dies, but then the second guy hires you to go somewhere with him for who the fuck knows what. But hey, it's not like you're short on work. Just don't fuck this one up, OK? I know you wanna know how this all plays out._ Tips: - Refuse the bribe to [continue the questline](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931908) Reward: - XP - Street Cred - Eurodollars (If the bribe is taken)

title: War Pigs
description: How to Start: Receive a call from Frank Nostra some time after completing [Transmission](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931837) _A voice from beyond the grave, the promise of dirt on old enemies... I'll admit, I'm a little curious. But in your shoes, I'd be careful with this one. Corpos are like wasps - they can sting even after they're dead._ Reward: - [Apparition](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931845) (if Frank is defeated)

title: Killing in the Name
description: How to Start: Receive a text from the Bartmoss Collective some time after completing [Transmission](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931837) _I'm curious about this Swedenborg-Riviera. To write that kinda nonsense, you've gotta have a good head. "Humanity is nothing but a pyramid scheme hidden behind a facade of tears..." Well, fuck me. What's this guy on? And where can I get some?_ Tips: - Can only be progressed after completing [A Like Supreme](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=934383) - In the first area, head to the top of a fire escape to find a router to hack Reward: - XP - Street Cred - Eurodollars

title: They Won't Go When I Go
description: How to Start: Complete [There Is A Light That Never Goes Out](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931807) and agree to help when Rachel calls you some time later. _Well, whaddaya know. This corpo-slut from the crucifixion BD wants you to come back to give her star a pep talk, massage his fucking shoulders and whatnot. Normally I'd tell you to drop it, find something more fun to do, but... I dunno, seems like this Jesus freak could really use your help._ Reward: - XP - Street Cred - Eurodollars

title: Send in the Clowns
description: How to Start: Accept Ozob Bozo's job when he texts you some time after [Transmission](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931837) _Ozob... Quite the name. Don't know why, but the sound of it gets creepy circus music stuck in my head. Maybe the dude was an acrobat or lion tamer or some shit. Never know in this city. And we won't know till we call him and find out._ Tips: - Just hope he doesn't sneeze! - Some time after this job, you'll unlock [Beat on the Brat: Pacifica](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=932202) Reward: - Eurodollars - [Ozob's Nose (Crafting Spec)](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931952)

title: Career Opportunities
description: How to Start: Beat a score of 401,210 in the Trauma Drama arcade game; machines can be found in multiple places, with one in the Red Dirt Bar. _Nice! You just got first place in an arcade game! Weren't joking when you said you'd become a Night City legend one day. And who cares if Trauma Team gleaned more of your personal data from it than if you'd showed up to MedCenter in person and pissed in a cup? Congrats! Just earned yourself the chance to apply for an unpaid internship at a blue-chip corp. Gotta admit, I'm actually pretty curious what they'd write back._ Reward: - [Mini Trauma Team AV](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=932006) - [Trauma Team uniform](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=932008)

title: The Highwayman
description: How to Start: Read the [Bad news](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=932070) shard. _That chick, Josie, wrote something about a garage, didn't she? Somewhere near the dam. Not like it's any of my biz, but if I were you, I'd go check it out. Something tells me it'll give you a boost in the right direction. A sixth sense, shall we say. On the other hand, I am basically dead, which would mean I don't think, so don't hold me to that._ Tips: - You'll find the bike [here](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=932072#L); use code 0214 to access the garage. Reward: - [Nazare "Itsumade"](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=932072)

title: Talkin' 'bout a Revolution
description: How to Start: Receive a text and call some time after completing [Ex-Factor](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931800) _There's no such thing as a free lunch, V. If someone invites you to a chow-down, someone's gonna pay. Who knows, maybe the bad guys'll saddle up - answer for all the bad shit they've done. But you know what I think? I think you're the one who's paying. And that check's well on its way._ Reward: - XP - Street Cred

title: Shape of a Pony
description: How to Start: Purchase the Porsche 911 Turbo Cariolet (930) from any Autofixer Terminal's 'Other' category. _I dunno if I should be flattered or embarrassed. It's a fine line beween superfan and superpsycho. But only a gonk says no to a Porsche 911 Turbo (930) – and a convertible at that. Especially if it's already bought and paid for._ Reward: - Eurodollars - Porsche 911 Turbo Cariolet (930)

title: Sweet Dreams
description: How to Start: Speak to Stefan, standing on a yellow line near the [Cherry Blossom Market](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=926141) fast travel spot. Note that he will not appear if [I Fought The Law](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931645) is active. _Everyone knows the most gut-twisting, brain-blitzing, 'dorph-jacking braindances aren't bought in stores or feeders, but on the streets, outside normal circulation. Take our fine man Stefan, here, as proof. Seems he's got the rawest BDs in the city - not for the faint of heart. Whaddaya say? Wanna take that rush to the next level?_ Tips: - Invest in arm cyberware (e.g gorilla arms, mantis blades) - Be sure to grab your loot from a locker Reward: - XP - Street Cred - Eurodollars

title: Beat on the Brat: Pacifica
description: How to Start: Receive a text from Coach Fred some time after completing [Send in the Clowns](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931951) _A throwdown in Pacifica, huh? Wonder who you're up against. I'd say a Haitian, though I guess that much is probably obvious. Careful, those Pacificans don't fight for first blood - they fight for last blood._ Tips: - Not the face! Reward: - Eurodollars

title: Motorbreath
description: How to Start: Receive a text from River some time after completing [I Fought The Law](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931645), and agree to look into the stolen car. _Auto theft? Sounds like the NCPD's problem – not that they'd ever actually do anything about it. Even if this gig is at a badge's request, for a chance to chase down a rare gem like a Semimaru, I say why the fuck not. I smell high-speed thrills comin' down the pike with this one. Sign me up._ Tips: - Save before you start searching for the Semimaru. - Equip a Cyberdeck that has vehicle quickhacks, or bring a FAST vehicle! - Be ready to fight two Cyberpsychos at once! Reward: - AUTOFIXER'S DISCOUNT EXTRAVAGANZZZA - [ARV-Q340 Semimaru](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=932234)

title: The Hunt
description: How to Start: Receive a call from River some time after completing [I Fought The Law](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931645) _NCPD boy in blue gives you a holler and you come runnin' like an obedient dog? This ain't gonna become a habit is it? Well, whatever - sounds like he's got an errand for you, real personal kind. Least it's better than chasing dead politicians. Just do me a favor - don't get used to it._ Tips: - The key for the drawer in Randy's bedroom is on a shelf by a covered window - If your intelligence is sub-15, use the record player to unlock the computer - If you've visited [Edgewood Farm](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=926681), the towers of light at the end of the last BD are the only clues required. Otherwise, the following list has all the clues, in order. - School BD clues: - Teacher - Two bulletin boards by door - Trophy case in corridor. - Farm BD clues: - Cow (scan it from the side) - Anthony's dad - Control panel - Injection system - Dietary supplements - Nasty BD clues: - Solar panel - Clock - Electrical parts - Fuel barrels - Victim (enlarged thyroid) - Heavy AV sounds - Victim (rapid heart rate) - Infusion pump - FDNC certificate - Victim (pumped with hormones) - Computer - Victim (afraid) - Number - Towers of light - Once you reach the farm, enter the house and head upstairs. Press a button underneath a desk in the bedroom to find a secret room holding [Tinker Bell](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=932255) - Female V will miss the chance to romance River if you say 'Do what you gotta do, but count me out' at the end. Reward: - XP - Street Cred

title: Where Eagles Dare
description: How to Start: Complete [Motorbreath](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=932230) and attempt to change the colour scheme of the [ARV-Q340 Semimaru](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=932234) via CrystalCoat _Your new ride's seen more shady shit than an NCPD burnout with a joytoy and blackjack addiction. From street races to body-bag ops to gettin' klepped by a pair of clowns... Yikes. A blue-chip gearjock built this beast to gobble up pavement, that much is obvious. But if it wound up in a badge's donut-crumbed clutches as their own personal murder-wagon, odds are the original owner is either long dead or long gone._ _History like that, must be more blood than polish on those rims. Still, it's lookin' sharp, minus the CrystalCoat bein' down and out. Either ex-street racer Claire will point you to the right fix... or she'll prove I'm right when I say that ride's just straight fuckin' cursed._ Reward: - Ability to change the Semimaru's colour scheme.

title: Dream On
description: How to Start: Receive a call from Jefferson some time after completing [I Fought The Law](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931645) _Well, well, special favors for politicians. You think you've got any clout here? The Peralezes might seem like decent and down-to-earth folk - not sitting snug in the corps' pockets like the rest. But they're still part of the ruling elite, V. If they gotta step over you to get to the top, they won't hesitate. Don't believe even for a second that they're any different._ Tips: - Invest in Body and Technical Ability for an easier investigation - Bring a vehicle to investigate the van - Focus on the two enemies that get out of the van to retrieve the [PROJECT CONDIN SUSPENDED](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=605772) shard. Reward: - XP - Street Cred - Eurodollars

title: Nitro (Youth Energy)
description: How to Start: Complete [Reported Crime: You Play With Fire...](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=926510), purchase all Yaiba bikes and at least one other vehicle from Autofixer, and check your emails in the [starter apartment](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=605021) for an invite to the event. _A special invitation from Yaiba? Well la-di-da, look at you – makin' a name, rubbin' elbows with the rich and famous. Just remember, contrary to all the advertising bullshit they try to shove through your Kiroshis, a shiny new toy ain't gonna change the dreams you chase, the air you breathe or the shits you take. New bike, new face, new pad, whatever – none of it changes what makes you you. That bein' said, if this custom bike does kick ass... at least you can tell the world to go fuck itself in style._ Tips: - Visit the event in person for some exclusive shards and a good ole' time! - When the bike arrives, bring 95,000 Eurodollars to actually buy it - The area where the bike is purchased is notoriously buggy; be ready to fight off some guards and robots. Reward: - ASM-R250 Muramasa

title: Pisces
description: How to Start: Receive a call from Judy some time after [Talkin' 'bout a Revolution](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=932073) _What's worse than a corpo? A wannabe corpo._ _You know what? I'm not even surprised you let yourself get talked into this little uprising. Hey, back in my day I would've bum rushed the riot shields in the name of joytoys' freedom or whatever... But this Maiko chick? I've got a bad feeling about her._ Tips: - Avoid accepting Maiko's bribe to continue Judy's [questline](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=932409) (and potential romance) - For a reasonably good outcome, attack Maiko, but do not kill her. - Be sure to grab [Tsumetogi](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=932388) Reward: - XP - Street Cred - Eurodollars

title: Following the River
description: How to Start: Receive a call from River some time after [The Hunt](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=932235), and agree to join him and Joss for dinner. _The Peter Pan case is done and closed, so you do know you never have to see this badge again... right? OK, fine, I get it, you crawled through shit and fire together, and now you wanna kick back and celebrate your victory. But a family dinner? Fuckin' seriously? Can't just find a decent dive to grab a tequila or ten? Smash the bottle over some corpocunt's face? You're getting soft, V._ Reward: - [Crash](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=932392) - [Big Trouble In Heywood](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=932391)

title: Pyramid Song
description: How to Start: Receive a call from Judy some time after [Pisces](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=932384) _Everyone knows you can't just count on yourself in this goddamn city. You always gotta have a few chooms who owe you a favor. And a few you've got dirt on too. But when you've got the kind of choom who starts asking you for weirder and weirder shit? That's when problems start._ Tips: - After equipping the diving suit, comment 'Looking fine in that wetsuit'. If you then romance Judy (only possible as Female V), you'll find some [unique MaxTac clothes](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=932998) inside a box in her apartment. - Sleep in the house after the dive to stay on good terms with Judy regardless of romance. - If you romanced Judy, say it was 'The beginning of something amazing' after spending the night together, or she'll leave the city. Reward: - [Diving Equipment](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=932995) - [Laguna Bend Photograph](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=932996) (if Judy is romanced) - [Mox](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=932997) (if you stay on good terms)

title: Freedom
description: How to Start: Receive a text from Muamar "El Capitan" Reyes some time after completing [Tapeworm](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=928057) and entering Act 3. _Rayfield... Every capitalist cunt's wet dream since who the fuck cares. These corpo assholes are all the same – they think they got a monopoly on innovation and pat themselves on the back for it. Truth is, whether you're chippin' the latest Kiroshi optics or sippin' bubbly in the comfort of a luxury AV, every piece of tech we touch was once some poor chump's intellectual property that was klepped by the corp and squeezed for every enny. Corpos are parasites, they feed off others' labor and shit out money. Auto industry ain't any different. El Cap wants you to thieve from these thieves. I say thieve away._ Tips: - The only consequence for continuing with the job is a wanted level - get your free car! - To that end, you'll need to find the skeleton key in the construction site. - Bring a fast car and gun for an easier time stopping the car when you find it. Reward: - [Caliburn "Mordred"](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=933131)

title: Chippin' In
description: How to Start: Complete [Tapeworm](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=928057) and enter Act 3. _This is it, Rogue's in for the kill - she's ready to stop running from her past and catch Smasher. And when we catch the bastard, I wanna be the one to pull the trigger. But for now - you're in charge. Happy hunting!_ Tips: - Spare or loot Grayson to get the key to Johnny's [911 Turbo (930)](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=934365) - For a secret ending, choose these dialogue options when visiting the oil fields, after Johnny mentions managing "not to fuck this up, what we have." - Nah, fucked that up too. - What do you want from me? - Ok. But as second chances go, this is your last. Reward: - Ability to reach the [Secret Ending](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=934367), if the right dialogue was picked in the oil field

title: Violence
description: How to Start: Receive a mysterious text some time after completing [Search and Destroy](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=933123) _Unknown number, anonymous client, a secret hotel meet-up... The aura of mystery 'round this one's so thick I need a machete to hack my way through it. Wonder what'll happen next... and what that means for you._ Tips: - The bartender can be paid for information - or threatened with a Body check - Liam can be extorted for a better payout, but this ends the questline early - unless you call Lizzy anyway - Tell Lizzy the truth to continue the quest; she'll call you after a few days. - Dispose of the body for a full reward. Reward: - XP - Street Cred - Eurodollars - [Lizzy Wizzy and the Metadwarves poster](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=934384)

title: Spellbound
description: How to Start: Receive a text from Nix. _A job from Nix? Should be interesting. Guy's got a rep for being an expert on antique tech, pre-Krash hardware. Decks, mag disks, yada yada yada. Some people'll tell you it's all as useful as a typewriter, a record player, a pile of dried cat shit. But me... I wouldn't be so sure about that._ Tips: - Invest in Intelligence for a higher payout Reward: - XP - Street Cred - Eurodollars

title: A Cool Metal Fire
description: How to Start: Give control to Johnny as part of [Chippin' In](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=933128) _Now, I don't ask you for much, but I gotta zero Smasher myself. That motherfucker thinks he's invincible. Worse, so does Rogue. All these years, Arasaka Tower's been haunting her. Enough's enough. I'm taking control this one time, I'm finding him, I'm wiping Adam Smasher off the face of the earth._ Reward: - Tattoo hand cyberware - [Johnny's Aviators](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=933175)

title: Tomorrow Never Comes
description: How to Start: Scan the [King of Cups](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=933226) card, or any of the others in Dogtown. _So, 'nother bunch of mystery murals, huh? Lemme read your future. You're walkin'... Walkin' down some street in Watson. You see a shop - "Misty's Esoterica". There's a chick inside... See her spewin' some mumbo-jumbo theories about what your special third eye managed to spy... Y'know, think I got a real knack for this fortune-telling stuff._ Reward: - None

title: Push It to the Limit
description: How to Start: Get into any [Mysterious Signal](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=934339) vehicle and receive a call from El Capitan. _Random car, random place and the usual suspect fixer. Chances are this is all exaaaactly what it looks like. But sure, could be worse. At least El Clowno always pays up._ Tips: - Drive carefully, if you can - it'll get you a better reward. Reward: - None

title: Blistering Love
description: How to Start: Have a heart-to-heart with Johnny during [Chippin' In](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=933128), and agree to give him a second chance. He'll ask you to invite Rogue on a date if done correctly. _Can't even remember why Rogue and I were always at each other's throats. All I remember is the good times - and how few of them there were. Now I've got one night to make it up to her. Yeah, a movie date sounds boring, but hell, we never did normal, boring things. Better late than never, right?_ Tips: - Just be yourself :) Reward: - XP - Street Cred

title: Holdin' On
description: How to Start: Complete [Blistering Love](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=934368) with any outcome, or [Chippin' In](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=933128) without giving Johnny a second chance. _The whole time I was flat on my digital ass in Mikoshi, Kerry was out there forging his glittering solo career. He'd better be real fucking chill after all these years, right? But something tells me deep down, he's still the same. Anyway, come on, guy's gonna shit himself when he sees me._ Tips: - Scan [The Lovers](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=926243) before you leave Reward: - XP - Street Cred

title: Second Conflict
description: How to Start: Complete [Holdin' On](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=934370) Tips: - If you dealt with [The Pickup](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=605044) peacefully, loot DumDum to get his iconic weapon [Doom Doom](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=934381) - Be sure to grab the [Gold-plated baseball bat](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=934382) out of the pool. Reward: - None

title: A Like Supreme
description: How to Start: Complete [Second Conflict](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=934380) Tips: - Break a leg! Reward: - XP - Street Cred - [Archangel](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=934387)

title: No Easy Way Out
description: How to Start: Receive a text from Coach Fred some time after leaving the safehouse as part of [Lucretia My Reflection](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=933325), and agree to help Aaron out. _Look, V. This Aaron choom is a big-handed bastard who knows how to handle himself in hot water. Sure, we gotta help each other out and all that, but watch your back. You're about to walk into the lion's den. I know you're all about helping lost souls and walking elderly ladies across the street, but please, PLEASE don't get killed assisting some lesser Dogtown boxer._ Tips: - If you decide to fight Angie during the encounter with her, the iconic weapon [Cheetah](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=955615) can be looted from her body. Reward: - Eurodollars - [Cheetah](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=955615)

title: Just Another Story
description: How to Start: Get into another Vehicle Contract vehicle after completing [Push It to the Limit](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=934352) _Looks like you're gettin' into the habit of "collecting" cars and bikes for Ol' Capitan. Say, V, ever hear the phrase "There is no job too small"? What am I saying, of course you have. It's obviously the code you live by._ Tips: - Have a gun equipped to deal with any tails Reward: - Random - New vehicles available to purchase from Autofixer (the first fourteen times the job is completed)

title: Rebel! Rebel!
description: How to Start: Receive a call from Kerry some time after [A Like Supreme](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=934383) _Look, I don't know if Kerry's just having a real late-life crisis, or whether his shrink's got him some on some sweet new meds, but I do know one thing: this gon' be good. Just meet with the guy. Won't be bored, I guarantee it. And Kerry needs some help. Always did. I got nothing against it, either. A friend in need is a friend indeed, and I've never been jealous of that second fiddle in my life._ Tips: - After the cops arrive, stay with Kerry or you'll be locked out his future jobs (and romance). Reward: - XP - Street Cred - Eurodollars

title: I Don't Wanna Hear It
description: How to Start: Receive a call from Kerry some time after [Rebel! Rebel!](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=934396) _And the crisis continues! Though Kerry might be barking mad up the wrong tree - those Us Crack girls are a symptom, not the cause. Could wipe 'em off the face of the earth, and those MSM bastards would still find some other two-bit gonk to sing his song. We're a dime-a-dozen whores to them, all of us. Chew up, spit out, rinse and repeat. On the other hand, world's crazy enough that even Eurodyne might be right. You're about to find out._ Tips: - Streetkid V can threaten the fanboy for cheaper tickets - Double jump up to the ladder in the alley for quick and easy access - plus an employee badge. - Invest in Technical Ability to get past the backstage huscle, or present the aforementioned employee badge. - Persuade Kerry to listen to (and accept) Us Cracks' deal to [unlock a job](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=934414) from one of them later. Reward: - XP - Street Cred

title: Off the Leash
description: How to Start: Receive a call from Kerry some time after [I Don't Wanna Hear It](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=934400) _You know, Kerry's whole escapade makes me think. People do change. He did, I mean - he made it to a crossroads, and now I can see his rockerboy heart pushing him down the right path. The problem, you ask? Kerry might've changed, but the city hasn't. And I think he knows it. Hell, so do you._ Tips: - Male V can kiss Kerry and begin a romance during this job. Reward: - None

title: Boat Drinks
description: How to Start: Receive a call from Kerry some time after [Off the Leash](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=934404) _You know, Kerry's whole escapade makes me think. People do change. He did, I mean - he made it to a crossroads, and now I can see his rockerboy heart pushing him down the right path. The problem, you ask? Kerry might've changed, but the city hasn't. And I think he knows it. Hell, so do you._ Tips: - Male V can kiss Kerry and continue a romance during this job. Reward: - [Record Player](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=934411) (if Kerry is romanced)

title: Every Breath You Take
description: How to Start: Receive a call from Blue Moon some time after completing [I Don't Wanna Hear It](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=934400) - but only if you agreed to hear them out. _Blue Moon has a problem. One that a publicist, an agent, or even an entourage can't solve. That's 'cause this is a problem with some actual meat on it, one that calls for somebody with a half-decent brain on their shoulders and some hot iron in their holster. Someone really loves her – or loves to hate her. You gotta find this guy and take him out. For most, an opportunity to help a big-time pop icon like her only happens once in a... well, you get it._ Tips: - ?? Reward: - XP - Street Cred - Eurodollars

title: Welcome to Paradise
description: How to Start: Complete [Playing for Time](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=606431) and reach Street Cred level 15, then receive a call from Aera. _An activist with a loud mouth goes missin' and her sister's desperate for answers. Kleppin' from people who can't forgive or forget ain't exactly the recipe to a long, cozy life. But, she did stash a shard before she ghosted - might be a clue to where her trail leads. From my experience, every corner of this city's full of powerful people itchin' to see truthtellers sink to the bottom of the bay. If she's lucky, maybe she can outrun 'em long enough for you to find her first._ Reward: - 950 XP - 2,200 Street Cred - 1,050 Eddies

title: Clampdown
description: How to Start: Complete [Playing for Time](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=606431), complete two Gigs for Wakako, and reach Street Cred level 15. Then, answer a text from Wakako about King. Reward: - Coronation (Iconic Tech Revolver) - King's Coat - King's Bulletproof Vest - King's Glasses - King's Pants - Icon America Dust Devil Utility Boots

title: Run This Town
description: How to Start: After finishing [Firestarter](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=1057620), you will get a call from Mr. Hands. Reward: - [Mancinella](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=1061948)

title: Developer Room
description: Lower section of the Kabuki Market, opposite some dumpsters. Type 605185 (seen in the corner of a leaflet included in physical launch versions of the game) into the lock to access a secret room. Inside, Johnny will play the guitar as pictures of the Cyberpunk 2077 dev team are displayed on a TV.

title: Portal reference
description: The 'Mean' Delamain variant encountered as part of [Epistrophy: Coastview](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=928032) is voiced by Ellen McLain, the actress behind the Portal' series own rogue AI, GLaDOS. Several of GLaDOS' iconic lines are referenced word-for-word, including: - Well, you found me. Congratulations. Was it worth it? - Your specimen has been processed and we are now ready to begin the test proper. - I'm going to kill you, and all the cake is gone. - You chose this path. Now I have a surprise for you. Deploying surprise in Five. Four. - I let you survive this long because I was curious about your behavior. Well, you've managed to destroy that part of me. - A bitter, unlikable loner whose passing shall not be mourned. - What's your point, anyway? Survival? - You're still shuffling around a little, but believe me you're dead. - The talking is over.

title: Ken Block reference
description: The vehicle featured in [I'm in Love with My Car](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=928038), styled with the name "Hoon" and number 43, are references to rally driver Ken Block.

title: The Office reference
description: As part of the [Big in Japan](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=928850) side job, you'll drop a man off here. Asking what his deal is prompts this response: _"In Japan, brain surgeon, top of all. Good instinct. One day, Tyger Claw boss need surgery. But, boss die on the table! Tyger Claws were very angry. I hide in boat, swim to America. Here Dennis save me. But there is secret - I kill Tyger Claw boss on purpose. World best surgeon make no mistake!"_ It's referencing a well-known gag from Season 6 episode 21 of The Office (US).

title: Fallout reference
description: The bodies found here, along with [Archived Conversation: Albert Cole and Gary Epps](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=929059) shard, are references to the Fallout series. Albert Cole is one of three pre-made characters in the first Fallout, and the LARP scenario he describes about finding a hydroprocessor before the bunker dwellers run out of fresh water parallels the hunt for a water chip. Gary Epps' name may be a reference to GURPS, a roleplaying system that Fallout used before legal squabbles necessitated the creation of S.P.E.C.I.A.L; Fallout was originally going to be named _Fallout: A GURPS Post-Nuclear Adventure._ Also, Bunker 101 is of course a reference to Vault 101 from Fallout 3.

title: Mad Max Fury Road reference
description: The bodies surrounding the fuel truck, and [nearby shard](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=929069), are references to the 2015 film Mad Max: Fury Road. The body near the shard has face paint bearing a striking resemblance to Furiosa, the character played by Charlize Theron; 'Charlize Fury' is a merging of the actress and characters' names. In the film, a fuel rig much like the one here is used to transport pregnant women. The shard on the ground mentions a similar situation, with one of the crew being Max - presumably a rather mad fella. There's also a large Biotechnica guard nearby with a half-removed mask; likely a reference to the film's main antagonist, Immortan Joe.

title: Breaking Bad reference
description: The RV in this spot has five bullet holes in its door, referencing the state of the RV from Breaking Bad.

title: Pulp Fiction reference
description: The bodies and [shard](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=929092) found here are references to the 1994 film Pulp Fiction. - 'Marsellus Wayans' is a nod to Marsellus Wallace - 'Vincent Vack' is a nod to Vincent Vega; one body is wearing a suit, just like the film character - The 'Butch' they mention is a nod to Butch Coolidge - The fatal boxing match is also a major part of the film's plot - The katana on the ground is a weapon used by Butch
